title: fix: name the timeout when a registry stops responding (pnpm/pnpm#3646)
body:
## Summary

When the registry stops sending data for longer than `fetchTimeout`, the final error did not say the request timed out. Closes pnpm/pnpm#3646.

Reproduced against a local registry that accepts the request and then stalls, with `fetchTimeout: 3000` and `fetchRetries: 1`, on pnpm 11.27.1 and 12.5.1:

| Stall | v11 before | v12 before |
|---|---|---|
| metadata, no response | `ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL GET …/stall-pkg: fetch failed` | `Failed to fetch metadata from …: error sending request for url (…)` |
| metadata, body stops | `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_METADATA_JSON terminated` | `Failed to read metadata response body from …: error decoding response body for url (…)` |
| tarball, no response | `[ERROR] fetch failed` plus stack | already ends in `operation timed out` |
| tarball, body stops | `[ERROR] terminated` plus stack | already ends in `operation timed out` |

With this change:

- v11: `ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL GET <url>: timed out, no data received for 3000ms` for metadata, `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_TIMEOUT` with the same message for tarballs, and a hint about the `fetchTimeout` setting. The retry warning for a stalled metadata body now shows `UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT` instead of `unknown`.
- v12: `Failed to fetch metadata from <url>: error sending request: operation timed out` and `Failed to read metadata response body from <url>: error decoding response body: request or response body error: operation timed out`.

Neither stack ever hung. Both already enforced `fetchTimeout`; only the message was missing.

## Squash Commit Body

```text
A request that hits fetchTimeout failed with an error that did not say so.
The TypeScript CLI reported undici's bare `fetch failed` or `terminated`
(a stalled metadata body even surfaced as BROKEN_METADATA_JSON) and kept
UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT / UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT only in `error.cause`. The
Rust CLI rendered metadata failures with reqwest's top-level Display, which
drops the `operation timed out` source.

TypeScript: detect undici's timeout codes in the cause chain and raise
FetchTimeoutError, keeping META_FETCH_FAIL for metadata and using
FETCH_TIMEOUT for tarballs, with a hint about fetchTimeout.

Rust: move the tarball error's reqwest source-chain walk into pnpm-network
and use it for the metadata Network and BodyRead errors, dropping the URL
reqwest repeats since the message already names it.

Closes pnpm/pnpm#3646
```

Written by an agent (Claude Code, Opus 5.5).
